sense: test what someone thinks, before asking outright

terms.comment: The verb is “to feel, handle, try”: of the pulse, vēnās temptāre (Quint. 11.3.88, Lewis & Short); of a person, to try what he will do or say.

sources: Lewis & Short: tento
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 98, checked against the searchable text and the page image (12 November 2026).
